value.body: A degree in social work. You study society, psychology, social policy and community work, and do supervised field work with NGOs, hospitals, schools or community groups. It leads to work in the social sector and to a Master of Social Work (MSW).

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4-year honours option at some universities under NEP 2020

items.label: Growth in enrolment
items.source: AISHE 2021-22 to 2023-24, all modes (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Many colleges admit on Class 12 marks; central universities and some others use CUET-UG, and a few run their own tests.

value.title: At a glance
items: Supervised field work is a core part of the course.
Specialised roles, such as medical or psychiatric social work, usually ask for an MSW.
Pay varies widely between NGOs, CSR foundations and government projects.
